GenAiFunction.description:
The agent action should be triggered only when the user specifically asks for coverage details from ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account). The trigger phrase will focus on requesting coverage details specifically from ABHA, such as:
"Get coverage details from ABHA."
"I want to see my ABHA coverage."
"Fetch my insurance details from ABHA."
The action should be triggered only when the user explicitly asks for coverage details from ABHA. Examples of such requests could be:
"Get my ABHA coverage details."
"Show me my coverage benefits from ABHA."
"Provide my ABHA insurance details." Do not trigger the action when the user asks for general insurance or coverage details that are not specifically related to ABHA. For example:
"What are my coverage details?"
"Show my insurance details."
"Tell me about my coverage benefits."
These queries should be answered using other data sources, such as the patient’s insurance file or coverage benefit records. If a user asks for general coverage details (e.g., "What are my coverage details?"), do not invoke the ABHA coverage API. Instead, you can display a message like:
"I can show you your coverage details from ABHA if you specify that you're asking for ABHA coverage details."
